$comment: The models rendered (render.py), with why; every other textured model is measured and predicted only. Labels are corpus labels (docs/validation.md, 'The corpus').
cave-a-raw: over the budget (607 MiB as ETC1S); known to need its texels (high tier expected)
object-a: over the budget (1,110 MiB, ETC1S already); known to hold about one octave too many (standard expected)
scan-44m: over the budget (299 MiB of textures, 16 UDIM images); geometry simplified at High's error to render
statue-b-large: under the budget (228 MiB), 14 images at 0.34 occupancy: 128 MiB gives 2816
collection-02: under the budget (192 MiB), 16 images: 128 MiB gives 3072, the measure says 1024
collection-23: under the budget (217 MiB), three 8k images: 128 MiB gives 6144
collection-31: under the budget (214 MiB), four 8k images almost fully used (0.99): 128 MiB gives 6144
collection-32: many small soft images (634), already under 128 MiB: halving is known to show
collection-13: one 8k image both measures call 4x oversampled
collection-52: one 8k image the measures disagree on: PSNR 4x, octave ratio 1x
collection-36: one 8k image the measures disagree on: PSNR 2x, octave ratio 1x

not rendered.object-b: over the budget only at its sources' 16384 side, which SwiftShader can't draw (8192 at most)
not rendered.site-a: over the budget by its geometry alone (2 GB); its one 8k image fits
